title: Campus Library Late-Night Study Hours Notice
context: Posted at the main entrance of Green Memorial Library
contentText:
NOTICE: Extended Final Exam Study Hours
From Monday, May 5 through Thursday, May 15, the Central Reading Room and 2nd Floor Study Commons will remain open 24 hours daily. Student ID card swipe access is required after 10:00 PM at the West entrance only. Campus Escort Shuttles depart every 20 minutes from 11:00 PM to 5:00 AM.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this notice?
options: To announce 24-hour library access and late-night shuttle service during final exams
To notify students that the Central Reading Room is closing for renovations
To recruit student employees for the campus night security desk
To introduce a new fee for overnight study carrel reservations
questions.why: The notice informs students that the Central Reading Room and Study Commons will remain open 24 hours daily during final exams and details entry and shuttle arrangements.

questions.q: What requirement must students meet to enter the library after 10:00 PM?
options: Reserve a designated study carrel 24 hours in advance
Present a valid student identification card at the West entrance
Register with the campus night security desk by phone
Pay a late-night facility fee at the circulation desk
questions.why: The notice clearly specifies that 'Student ID card swipe access is required after 10:00 PM at the West entrance only.'

title: Apartment Maintenance and HVAC Inspection Notice
context: Email from Oakridge Student Living Management to all building residents
contentText:
Subject: Mandatory Semi-Annual HVAC Filter Replacement & Smoke Detector Audit
Dear Residents,
Our certified facilities maintenance technicians will enter all apartment suites on Wednesday, October 18, between 9:00 AM and 4:00 PM to replace air intake filters and test emergency smoke alarms. You do not need to be present during the inspection; however, please ensure all household pets are secured in a bedroom or travel crate. Technicians will leave a completion card on your kitchen counter once the check is finalized. If your deadbolt lock has been privately modified, please contact the leasing office immediately.

questions.q: Why did Oakridge Student Living Management send this email to residents?
options: To prohibit residents from keeping household pets inside student apartments
To announce a monthly rent increase for suites with privately modified locks
To notify residents of an upcoming mandatory apartment maintenance and safety inspection
To offer optional air-conditioning upgrades for the winter semester
questions.why: The email informs residents that maintenance technicians will enter suites on October 18 to replace HVAC filters and test smoke alarms.

questions.q: What are residents instructed to do regarding their pets during the maintenance visit?
options: Remove them from the apartment premises entirely for the entire day
Register them with the building manager before 9:00 AM
Leave them in the main living room with food and water
Secure them inside a bedroom or an enclosed travel crate
questions.why: The email explicitly requests: 'please ensure all household pets are secured in a bedroom or travel crate.'

questions.q: What can be inferred about apartments with privately modified deadbolt locks?
options: Technicians may be unable to enter them using standard master keys unless the leasing office is notified
They are exempt from the semi-annual smoke detector inspection
Residents in those units will be evicted immediately
Their air intake filters were already replaced last month
questions.why: Because technicians must enter all suites even when residents are not home, a privately modified deadbolt lock would prevent standard key entry unless coordinated with the leasing office.

title: Biology Lab Group Project Coordination Text Chain
context: Text message chain among three biology lab partners
contentText:
Marcus (1:15 PM): Hey guys, Dr. Alvarez just posted the rubric for our water ecology report. We need 4 peer-reviewed citations minimum.
Elena (1:17 PM): I already pulled two journal articles on microplastic filtration in local watersheds from JSTOR.
Sam (1:19 PM): Perfect. I can crunch the lab sample numbers into comparison charts tonight. Can we meet at the campus cafe tomorrow at 3 PM to merge our drafts?
Marcus (1:22 PM): I have organic chemistry lab until 3:30 PM. Could we do 4:00 PM at the science library seminar room instead?
Elena (1:23 PM): 4:00 PM works for me! I will reserve Room 3B right now.
Sam (1:24 PM): Sounds good, see you both at 4.

questions.q: Why is Marcus unable to meet at the campus cafe at 3:00 PM?
options: He has to work a shift at the campus library
He must complete another laboratory class until 3:30 PM
He has an advising appointment with Dr. Alvarez
He needs to finish analyzing the microplastic data
questions.why: Marcus explicitly states: 'I have organic chemistry lab until 3:30 PM.'

questions.q: What does Sam mean by the informal phrase 'crunch the lab sample numbers'?
options: Delete inaccurate measurements from the laboratory notebook
Collect additional water specimens from the local watershed
Process and analyze the quantitative data from the water samples
Print physical copies of the grading rubric for the group
questions.why: In informal usage, 'crunch the numbers' means to calculate, process, and analyze numerical data.

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of this text message exchange?
options: To request an extension on a laboratory assignment deadline
To debate scientific findings regarding local watershed contamination
To complain about the professor's strict grading expectations
To coordinate research tasks and schedule a group meeting time
questions.why: The students are dividing up research tasks and agreeing on a time and room to merge their drafts.

title: University Career Fair Company Presentation Schedule
context: Printed guide for the Annual STEM & Business Career Expo at the Student Union
contentText:
FALL CAREER EXPO — AUDITORIUM SESSIONS
• 10:00 AM – 10:45 AM: Apex Robotics (Session A) — Automated Logistics Internships [Open to all engineering majors]
• 11:00 AM – 11:45 AM: GreenGrid Utilities (Session B) — Renewable Grid Solutions & Entry-level Analyst Roles [Resume drop encouraged]
• 12:00 PM – 1:00 PM: Networking Lunch Break (Complimentary buffet in West Lounge for pre-registered attendees)
• 1:15 PM – 2:00 PM: Vanguard FinTech (Session C) — Quantitative Trading & Software Engineering [Bring portfolio code samples]
• 2:15 PM – 3:00 PM: BioHealth Labs (Session D) — Clinical Research Associate Trainee Positions [Prerequisite: 16+ credits in biology or chemistry]

questions.q: Which organization specifically recommends that attendees bring samples of their programming code?
options: Vanguard FinTech
Apex Robotics
GreenGrid Utilities
BioHealth Labs
questions.why: The schedule states for Vanguard FinTech at 1:15 PM: '[Bring portfolio code samples]'.

questions.q: What does the phrase 'Resume drop encouraged' in the GreenGrid Utilities listing mean?
options: Students are advised to omit prior work experience from their applications
Applicants should leave printed copies of their resumes with company representatives
Attendees must cancel their registration before 11:00 AM
The session has been canceled due to low student turnout
questions.why: At a career fair, a 'resume drop' refers to submitting or handing in one's resume directly to recruiters.

questions.q: What can be inferred about a mechanical engineering freshman who has taken no biology or chemistry courses?
options: The student automatically qualifies for the Clinical Research Associate position
The student is prohibited from attending any morning sessions at the Career Expo
The student is eligible to attend Session A, but does not meet the prerequisite for Session D
The student must pay an admission fee to enter the Auditorium
questions.why: Session A (Apex Robotics) is open to all engineering majors, whereas Session D (BioHealth Labs) requires 16+ credits in biology or chemistry.

title: Campus Dining Hall Daily Specials & Allergen Advisory
context: Dining Services digital display board at North Quad Cafeteria
contentText:
TODAY'S SPECIALS — NORTH QUAD DINING COMMONS
• Station 1 (Global Hearth): Roasted Moroccan Chickpea Tagine with saffron couscous [Vegan, Nut-Free, Halal]
• Station 2 (Chef's Grill): Grass-Fed Herb Burgers served with sweet potato wedges. Gluten-free buns available upon request [Contains dairy; egg-free]
• Station 3 (Pacific Wok): Ginger Sesame Tofu Stir-Fry over brown rice [Contains soy & sesame; Vegetarian]
• Station 4 (Fresh Market Deli): Smoked Turkey Panini on sourdough with cranberry goat cheese [Contains gluten and dairy]
ALLERGEN NOTE: All deep-fried items are prepared in equipment shared with peanut and shellfish oils. Cross-contact may occur. Ask Chef Ramon for dedicated allergy prep.

questions.q: Which dining option is explicitly labeled as suitable for individuals seeking a vegan and nut-free meal?
options: Smoked Turkey Panini at Station 4
Grass-Fed Herb Burger at Station 2
Ginger Sesame Tofu Stir-Fry at Station 3
Moroccan Chickpea Tagine at Station 1
questions.why: Station 1 specifies: 'Roasted Moroccan Chickpea Tagine with saffron couscous [Vegan, Nut-Free, Halal]'.

questions.q: All of the following ingredients or allergens are mentioned in the station descriptions EXCEPT:
options: Eggs
Dairy
Sesame
Gluten
questions.why: Station 2 explicitly states 'egg-free', whereas sesame (Station 3), dairy (Stations 2 and 4), and gluten (Station 4) are present.

questions.q: What can be inferred about students who require special dietary accommodations?
options: They cannot eat at North Quad Commons under any circumstances
They can speak with Chef Ramon to arrange dedicated meal preparation
They must bring meals prepared outside the university campus
They have to submit medical clearance forms two days prior
questions.why: The text advises diners to 'Ask Chef Ramon for dedicated allergy prep', implying custom assistance is available upon request.

title: Campus Bookstore Course Material Invoice & Return Policy
context: Customer receipt from Pioneer University Bookstore
contentText:
PIONEER BOOKSTORE — TRANSACTION #89421
Date: Jan 14 | Register: 04 | Cashier: David K.
----------------------------------------
1. Organic Chem 4th Ed. (Used Rental) .... $48.50
2. Lab Safety Goggles (New) ............. $12.00
3. Graphing Calculator TI-84 (New) ..... $115.00
Subtotal: $175.50 | Tax (7.5%): $13.16 | Total Paid: $188.66
----------------------------------------
RETURN POLICY: Course textbooks and digital access codes may be returned for a full refund within the first 10 days of classes with original receipt and undamaged shrinkwrap. Calculators and electronics are subject to a 15% restocking fee if packaging is unsealed. Rental textbooks must be returned by 5:00 PM on Friday of finals week to avoid auto-replacement billing.

questions.q: Under what condition will a customer incur a 15% fee when returning an item?
options: Returning a textbook after the first 10 days of the semester
Requesting cash rather than store credit for safety goggles
Returning electronic equipment with opened packaging
Exchanging a rental book for an updated hardcover edition
questions.why: The policy states: 'Calculators and electronics are subject to a 15% restocking fee if packaging is unsealed.'

questions.q: What does the term 'auto-replacement billing' mean in the return policy?
options: Replacing damaged lab goggles at no additional charge
Issuing an automatic refund to the customer's original credit card
Renewing the textbook rental for an additional academic semester
Automatically charging the student's account for the full cost of a replacement book
questions.why: 'Auto-replacement billing' means the bookstore automatically bills the renter for the cost of replacing an unreturned rental textbook.

questions.q: What can be inferred about the customer who made Transaction #89421?
options: The customer is most likely enrolled in quantitative science or chemistry coursework
The customer purchased only digital e-books during this visit
The customer works as a cashier at Pioneer Bookstore
The customer returned a graphing calculator on January 14
questions.why: The customer rented an Organic Chemistry textbook and purchased lab safety goggles and a graphing calculator, strongly implying enrollment in science/math courses.

title: Email Regarding Campus Parking Permit Renewals
context: Official message sent from Transportation & Parking Services to commuter students
contentText:
Subject: Spring Semester Commuter Parking Permits Now Available Online
Dear Student,
Online renewal for Spring Commuter (Zone C) parking permits opens Monday, December 1st at 8:00 AM via your MyCampus portal. Due to upcoming construction on the South Garage, Zone C permit quotas have been reduced by 15% this term. Permits will be awarded on a strict first-come, first-served basis. If your vehicle license plate or residential address has changed since fall term, you must update your vehicle profile prior to submitting your permit request. Physical hangtags are no longer issued; your license plate serves as your digital permit.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this email?
options: To notify students that all campus parking garages will be permanently closed
To inform commuter students about the opening and updated rules for spring parking permit renewals
To issue a parking citation for an unregistered license plate
To distribute plastic rearview mirror hangtags by campus mail
questions.why: The email announces when Spring Commuter permit renewal opens and explains reduced quotas, profile updates, and digital license-plate permits.

questions.q: Why has the number of available Zone C parking permits been decreased?
options: The university is increasing regional public transit subsidies
Permit prices have increased significantly for the spring term
Construction work is scheduled to take place on the South Garage
Commuter student enrollment has fallen over the past semester
questions.why: The email notes: 'Due to upcoming construction on the South Garage, Zone C permit quotas have been reduced by 15% this term.'

questions.q: The word 'quotas' in the email is closest in meaning to:
options: enforcement fines
geographic boundaries
maintenance expenses
predetermined limits
questions.why: In this context, 'permit quotas' refers to the set maximum limits or allotments of permits available.

title: University IT Service Desk Outage Advisory
context: Portal notification from University Information Technology
contentText: SYSTEM ADVISORY: University IT will perform database upgrades Saturday, March 12, from 1:00 AM to 6:00 AM. During this five-hour window, Canvas, cloud drives, and course registration will be offline. Campus Wi-Fi and university email (@university.edu) will operate normally. Faculty have been asked not to schedule quiz deadlines during this window.

questions.q: Which service will NOT be offline during Saturday's maintenance window?
options: University email and campus Wi-Fi networks
The student course registration portal
The Canvas course management system
Campus cloud file storage drives
questions.why: The notice explicitly confirms: 'Campus Wi-Fi and university email (@university.edu) will operate normally.'

questions.q: What can be inferred about students who need to submit a Canvas assignment on Saturday?
options: They must visit the IT Service Desk in person to reset their passwords
They will be unable to upload files to Canvas between 1:00 AM and 6:00 AM
Their university email accounts will be erased during the upgrade
They will be charged a late fee for logging in after 6:00 AM
questions.why: Because Canvas will be offline from 1:00 AM to 6:00 AM on Saturday, students cannot upload assignments to Canvas during that five-hour window.
